v1_3_pre_arm_addendum.change: Added static dirichlet_sparse (alpha=0.25) control arm to mo-lunar-lander-v3 (+10 GPU runs, ~9.5 GPU-h) so Table 1 provides a symmetric 3-arm showdown (uniform vs dirichlet_sparse vs fixed_face_balanced) across all three core d >= 3 benchmarks (d = 3, 4, 6).
v1_3_pre_arm_addendum.trigger_evidence: research/evidence/stage1a_cpu_exact_oracle_dev_v1.json (commit b8502af): dirichlet_sparse(0.25) achieved -64.9% non-vertex regret vs uniform on fruit-tree-v0 (d=6, n=12, p=0.00049) and outperformed fixed_face_balanced (0.2432 vs 0.3562, p=0.0210, 10/12 seeds) while passing strict shifted interior retention (+0.50%, CI [-0.06%, +1.10%]).
v1_3_pre_arm_addendum.firewall_confirmation: Authorized BEFORE any Stage-1A GPU arm run started; primary Holm k=3 endpoint (fixed_face_balanced vs uniform on argmax non-vertex face-cap regret) and final_test_steps = 0 remain unchanged.

primary_research_question: Does static on-policy simplex-face exposure reduce deployed non-vertex face-cap regret across d >= 3 benchmarks (and as d increases within fruit-tree-v0 d in {3,4,5,6}) while preserving reference-shifted interior utility (95% CI lower bound >= -1.5%), with hindsight relabeling disabled?

claim_scope_adjudication.minecart_sampled_rho_090_adjudication: Week-1 Step-2.1 Minecart checkpoint audit hit sampled Spearman rho = 0.90 (exact on n=5 due to single-preference specialist S anchoring rank 5; 0.80 argmax / 0.60 conditional-only), and n=5 carries low inferential weight. We explicitly drop any claim that deployed face-cap regret is a standalone novel evaluation metric and scope the contribution strictly to the on-policy non-relabeling simplex-face exposure intervention.

learner_contract.popart_algebraic_note: Positive diagonal PopArt rescaling diag(sigma) e_i proportional to e_i leaves exact simplex vertices invariant; normalization distortion applies strictly to near-face mixed-weight regions, never exact corners.
learner_contract.anchor_freeze_before_evaluation_rule: All 21 vertex-specialist anchor runs (9 Minecart + 12 Lunar; final fixed-budget checkpoint only) MUST be trained, frozen, and SHA-256 hashed BEFORE evaluating any Stage-1A arm checkpoint.

stage1a_primary_contrast.distribution: i.i.d. Dirichlet(1_d) per episode on Delta^{d-1}

stage1a_sparse_prior_control.distribution: i.i.d. Dirichlet(0.25 * 1_d) per episode; concentrates mass near simplex boundaries with zero point mass on exact vertices
stage1a_sparse_prior_control.reporting_rule: Reported as a predeclared secondary static-control contrast against fixed_face_balanced on non-vertex face-cap regret; if dirichlet_sparse ties or beats fixed_face_balanced, report sparse-prior sufficiency honestly.

stage1b_conditional_adaptive_expansion.unlock_condition: Unlocked ONLY after Stage-1A completes and coordinator+Gate review confirms residual boundary regret justifying adaptive allocation.

arms.description: Executes identical curriculum-evaluation steps as adaptive_face_balanced but updates allocation weights from random scores.
Outcome-dependent preference allocation over face-stratified support with matched total training + curriculum + update budgets.

stage1b_conditional_adaptive_expansion.adaptive_benefit_decision_rule: Claim adaptive benefit ONLY if adaptive_face_balanced beats BOTH fixed_face_balanced AND compute_matched_random on the primary non-vertex face-cap regret endpoint at strictly matched total environment and optimizer budgets (Holm-adjusted paired permutation p < 0.05 and 95% paired bootstrap CI excluding 0) while satisfying the interior-utility non-inferiority criterion (95% CI lower bound >= -0.015). If fixed_face_balanced ties or beats adaptive_face_balanced, report the static face-exposure sufficiency result honestly.

secondary_minecart_2x2_normalization_con.reporting_rule: Deferred out of Stage-1A to keep initial GPU budget lean; if activated later and null, move to appendix.

benchmarks.exclusion_rationale: At d=2, epsilon-cap volume scales linearly O(epsilon), so d=2 cannot test exponential O(epsilon^(d-1)) simplex-boundary starvation; retained strictly as a low-dimensional sanity check outside the k=3 Holm family.

primary_non_vertex_face_cap_composition.weighting: equal_per_preference (100% vertex_cap; no proper 1-faces at d=2)

fruit_tree_d_subset_scaling_sweep.purpose: De-confound objective dimension d from environment identity by testing d in {3, 4, 5, 6} within the fixed fruit-tree-v0 environment using exact discounted oracles on CPU.

d_scaling_test_statistic.primary_endpoint_per_seed: relative_non_vertex_regret_reduction(d, s) = (R_unif(d, s) - R_fb(d, s)) / max(1e-12, R_unif(d, s)) in argmax mode
d_scaling_test_statistic.secondary_endpoint_per_seed: absolute_non_vertex_regret_reduction(d, s) = R_unif(d, s) - R_fb(d, s)
d_scaling_test_statistic.test_statistic: OLS slope beta_d of paired seed-level relative_non_vertex_regret_reduction(d, s) regressed on d in {3, 4, 5, 6}
d_scaling_test_statistic.confidence_interval: 95% stratified seed-bootstrap CI (10000 resamples within each d)
d_scaling_test_statistic.hypothesis_test: One-sided permutation test (10000 permutations of d labels across paired seeds) testing H1: beta_d > 0 at alpha = 0.05
d_scaling_test_statistic.sparse_prior_comparison: Also compute OLS slope beta_d for fixed_face_balanced vs dirichlet_sparse(alpha=0.25) and report prominently regardless of significance.

subsets.note: Reuses the 12-seed core fruit-tree-v0 (d=6) Stage-1A runs (0 duplicate runs).

single_primary_endpoint_per_benchmark.name: argmax_deployed_non_vertex_face_cap_mean_regret
single_primary_endpoint_per_benchmark.exact_oracle_benchmarks: exact non-negative mean regret (fruit-tree-v0, fruit-tree d-subsets)
single_primary_endpoint_per_benchmark.approximate_reference_benchmarks: unclamped mean signed gap U_ref - U_deploy (minecart-v0, mo-lunar-lander-v3), reported alongside fraction_clipped

metrics_and_analysis.apm_sign_guard_and_archive_blindness_pol: Always report magnitude-guarded APM (U_F < U_F0 - tau * |U_F0|) as primary APM and reference-shifted APM as secondary; never report raw unguarded Eq. 2 on negative-utility benchmarks without flagging self-abandonment. Explicitly disclose in the paper that front-based APM inherits Archive Blindness by construction.
metrics_and_analysis.edge_cap_sampling_disclosure: sample_edge_cap_preferences samples a truncated mid-edge band (on-edge split in [0.15, 0.85], omitting the (1-m) Jacobian) inside {w_i + w_j >= 1 - epsilon}; describe accurately in the paper rather than claiming exact Lebesgue uniformity on the full edge cap.

interior_utility_retention_margin.sole_criterion: Lower bound of 95% paired bootstrap CI on relative reference-shifted interior-uniform utility change (U_tilde_FB - U_tilde_Unif) / U_tilde_Unif >= -0.015, where U_tilde(w) = w^T (g(w) - r_ref) > 0 uses each benchmark's frozen reference_point. Strictly required with no point-estimate fallback.
interior_utility_retention_margin.pilot_calibration_basis: Week-1 fruit-tree-v0 (n=10, r_ref=0) achieved +0.40% point change with 95% CI lower bound -0.63%.

statistical_protocol.hypothesis_test: exact paired sign-flip permutation test across training seeds (never across episodes)
statistical_protocol.multiplicity_control: Holm-Bonferroni strictly across the k=3 core benchmarks on the single primary endpoint (argmax_deployed_non_vertex_face_cap_mean_regret)

metrics_and_analysis.final_test_firewall: Final-test preference splits (seeds *91) are strictly locked until training completes and all final-budget checkpoints (including all 21 vertex-specialist anchors) are frozen and SHA-256 hashed. Zero tuning, normalization, or checkpoint selection on final-test splits.

compute_budget_and_routing.matched_hardware_pairing_rule: All arms (uniform, fixed_face_balanced, and dirichlet_sparse where enabled) for any given training seed MUST execute on identical hardware, OS, Python/Torch/CUDA versions, and backend. Never mix local RTX 4060, Kaggle T4, and Colab inside a single paired contrast.
